decisionsForDave: RAIL-2 [needed before Rail implementation]: A) use an Apps dialog below 720px and a labeled rail at 1440px+ (recommended for usable phone width), or B) keep literal v3's persistent 56px icon rail at every width?

RAIL-3 [needed before Rail implementation]: A) implement local pin/unpin/reorder/reset in sbd.rail.v1 (recommended for reversible operator preferences), or B) keep literal v3's fixed order with Customize as future status only?
Retire the 8 legacy Video pages once AV Video imports all 8 keys, or keep them live indefinitely?
Minimum iOS/iPadOS for field use: 17.4+ (checkVisibility) or add fallbacks for older iPads?
Throwline: keep explicit-save only (edited width resets on reload) or add a draft autosave?
Stream & Record: block raw stream keys outright on import/export, or keep warning-only?
